# inngest_webhooks (Data Source)

Lists the webhooks of an Inngest environment, including ones created in the dashboard. The webhook URLs are sensitive.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# All webhooks of an environment, including ones made in the dashboard.
data "inngest_webhooks" "production" {
  environment = "production"
}

output "webhook_names" {
  value = [for w in data.inngest_webhooks.production.webhooks : w.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String) Environment to list webhooks for, sent as the `X-Inngest-Env` header. Defaults to the provider's `environment`, then to `production`.

### Read-Only

- `webhooks` (Attributes List) The webhooks, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks))

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `environment` (String) Environment the webhook belongs to.
- `event_filter` (Attributes) Event filter, if set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--webhooks--event_filter))
- `id` (String) Webhook ID.
- `name` (String) Webhook name.
- `response` (String) JavaScript function that answers GET requests, if set.
- `transform` (String) JavaScript transform function.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).
- `url` (String, Sensitive) The webhook URL.

<a id="nestedatt--webhooks--event_filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `webhooks.event_filter`

Read-Only:

- `events` (Set of String) Event names or patterns.
- `filter` (String) `ALLOW` or `DENY`.
